title: PerSo: Investigating Facets of LLMs' Social Intelligence in Real-World Persuasion Scenarios
abstract: arXiv:2610.20548v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding the social intelligence of large language models (LLMs) is increasingly important for applications involving human-AI interaction and multi-agent environments. Social intelligence comprises two aspects: cognitive intelligence, the ability to infer others' mental states, and behavioral intelligence, the ability to select appropriate social actions based on these inferences to achieve social goals. Persuasion provides a natural testbed in which both aspects are simultaneously at play, yet prior benchmarks typically evaluate them in isolation using synthetic scenarios. We introduce PerSo, a benchmark that evaluates both aspects on real-world persuasion dialogues from Reddit's ChangeMyView community, using an LLM-in-the-loop pipeline to construct the evaluation tasks, validated through human annotation. translated_title: PerSo：在现实世界说服场景中探究大语言模型社会智能的多个维度
translated_abstract: 理解大语言模型（LLM）的社会智能对于涉及人机交互和多智能体环境的应用而言日益重要。社会智能包含两个方面：认知智能，即推断他人心理状态的能力；以及行为智能，即基于这些推断选择恰当的社会行动以实现社交目标的能力。说服为同时考察这两个方面提供了一个天然的测试平台，然而以往的基准测试通常采用合成场景将二者分开评估。我们提出了PerSo，这是一个基于Reddit的ChangeMyView社区真实世界说服对话来评估这两个方面的基准，采用LLM在环（LLM-in-the-loop）流水线构建评估任务，并通过人工标注加以验证。我们对多种LLM的评估表明，性能总体上随模型规模增大而提升，但在不同维度上表现各异。最强的……
tldr: 该论文提出了PerSo基准，利用Reddit ChangeMyView社区的真实说服对话，同时评估大语言模型社会智能中的认知智能（推断他人心理状态）与行为智能（选择合适社会行动）两个方面。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces PerSo, a benchmark built on real-world persuasion dialogues from Reddit's ChangeMyView community that jointly evaluates both cognitive and behavioral facets of LLMs' social intelligence.
